text: OI! Listen up you drongos, some bloke in Sydney just paid NINE HUNDRED GRAND for a garage with a bloody kitchen bolted on!
action: shadow boxing the air then jabbing finger directly at camera lens

text: They're calling it a 'micro-loft investment opportunity', mate! No wuckas, they said! It's got a SHOWER in the PANTRY!
action: flexes both biceps while wiping imaginary sweat off forehead

text: Yeah nah. Sounds cosy. Bloke can shower and make a sanga same time. Efficient, really.
action: slow blink while chewing gum leaf, sips from stubby holder without breaking eye contact

text: This episode is proudly brought to you by absolutely NO ONE, because our sponsor pulled out faster than a bloke doing a runner from a share house inspection!
action: throws arms wide gesturing to empty studio like a game show host

text: So instead we're spruiking Kev's Genuine Leaf Mulch. Eat it, sleep on it, or use it as a house deposit. Same buying power, fair dinkum.
action: holds up a leaf to the lens then drops it with zero enthusiasm

text: STREWTH Kev, this is a fair dinkum crisis! My cousin's renting a BUNK BED, mate! A BUNK BED! Top or bottom, doesn't matter, it's still six hundred a week!
action: paces aggressively, points at Kev then slams open palm on the desk

text: Ground control to Boomer. Mate's lucky. I've seen blokes bidding on a tent peg in Byron. Went for four hundred grand. Had ocean glimpse, apparently.
action: yawns wide then slowly sips from stubby holder, eyelids drooping

text: So what's the fix then, genius?! What's the ACTUAL game changer?!
action: stops pacing, spins to face Kev, both arms out demanding an answer

text: Move to Tassie. Buy a shed. Call it 'rustic'. Wrap this up.
action: shrugs once, closes eyes mid-sentence and goes completely still
